name: Seraiah (son of Tanhumeth)
title: Commander after the fall of Jerusalem
summary: Seraiah, son of Tanhumeth from Netophah, was one of the commanders who came to the governor Gedaliah in Mizpah after the fall of Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Comes to Gedaliah
keyEvents.description: Seraiah, son of Tanhumeth, was among the commanders who joined Gedaliah in Mizpah.
